events.title: Worm Capitalist Launches November 30! 🪱💰
events.summary: Hey Worm CEOs! The wait is almost over: Worm Capitalist will be releasing on November 30, 2026! There's nothing more to say. Time is money. Play the demo during Steam Next Fest, wishlist the game, and start making money. Now. 💵💵💵 Got feedback from the demo or found a bug? Drop it in the discussions or come say hi on our Discord. We read everything.📧 Sign up for our Newsletter🎮 Follow us on Steam▶️ Join our Discord

events.title: 1,000+ Steam Wishlists! 🪱❤️

events.title: Worm Capitalist x Ivy Juice
events.summary: Hey everyone,this is Linus from Ivy Juice! We are really happy to announce that we will be supporting Tikotey with publishing Worm Capitalist. To celebrate the announcement, we got a new little Trailer and a Demo update for you! The demo update includes:Added Steam Achievements Polishing, UX updates Bug Fixing Watch the new trailer now:A little introduction to Ivy Juice: We are a two person publishing and development studio based in Berlin, Germany! We help solo developers shipping their titles.

events.title: 500+ Steam Wishlists!! 🪱❤️
events.summary: We just passed 500 Wishlists for Worm Capitalist!A few stats since the Steam demo launched:1,500+ demo claims750+ unique playersaround 57 minutes median playtime46% of players played for at least 1 hourover 100,000 Steam impressionsand we’ve gained around 200 wishlists since the demo launch12 reviews (91% Positive) on the Demo For my first commercial game, this honestly means a lot. Thank you to everyone who played, left feedback, shared the game, or added it to their wishlist ❤️Next goal: 1,000
